entities.name: Monastery of Gix
entities.description: A monastery in far north Terisiare built over an abyss near Ronom Lake, home to the Brotherhood of Gix.

entities.name: Brotherhood of Gix
entities.description: A religious cult worshipping the machine god Gix.

entities.name: Gix
entities.description: A machine god worshipped by the Brotherhood.

entities.name: Church of Tal
entities.description: Rising church that began the First Talite Crusade purge of Gixian lands.

entities.name: Conclave of Mages
entities.description: Organization built from the monastery's ruins around 75 AR.

entities.name: Ith
entities.description: Imprisoned in a cage over the pit where the abyss had been.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: Where the cult traveled after being turned mechanical.

entities.name: Koilos
entities.description: Where monks activated the portal to Phyrexia.

entities.name: First Talite Crusade
entities.description: Church of Tal's purge of the Gixian lands.

events.summary: Monks from the monastery travel to Koilos and activate the portal to Phyrexia.
events.quote: several of the monks from the monastery traveled to Koilos and activated the portal to Phyrexia

events.summary: The Church of Tal begins the First Talite Crusade with a purge of the Gixian lands; the monastery is abandoned.
events.quote: the rising Church of Tal began the First Talite Crusade with a purge of the Gixian lands

relations.note: They worship the machine god Gix.
relations.quote: a religious cult worshipping a machine god named Gix
